recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a male musician standing behind an acoustic guitar, set against a heavily textured matte black background. The composition uses a strong vertical axis on the left for the subject, balanced by large, bold, ochre-colored typography on the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject blending into the dark background via low-key lighting
Bright acoustic guitar body acting as the primary visual anchor
Bold ochre text contrasting against the dark, textured negative space
Horizontal dotted line separating primary and secondary text blocks
coreInvariants: Textured black background with visible grain or stucco-like surface
Musician's hands resting on the headstock of the guitar
High-contrast lighting focusing on face, hands, and guitar
Ochre or mustard-yellow color for all primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician and guitar positioned on the left third of the frame, full vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The light-colored wood of the acoustic guitar body in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the musician's face, moves down to the hands and guitar, then sweeps right to the large display typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive textured black space occupying the center and right-middle of the composition.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black background and the yellow text/light wood.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with delicate horizontal serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'y' with a sharp, straight descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed serif for impact paired with a functional condensed sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Horizontal row of small ochre circles/dots as a divider

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy verticality and serif style of the display text.
Appropriate for the secondary metadata text at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man in a dark jacket standing behind a light-wood acoustic guitar. The background is a heavily textured, matte black wall. Low-key lighting illuminates only his face, hands, and the guitar. The man's hands are folded over the guitar's headstock. The right side of the image is empty textured black space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed serif text in ochre yellow in the upper right quadrant. Include a horizontal row of small yellow dots between the two main lines of text. Add small-scale uppercase sans-serif text in the same ochre color below the main title and at the very bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar the brightest element in the lower half?
Is the text color a consistent ochre/mustard yellow?
Is the background texture visible and not a flat digital black?
Is the subject positioned off-center to the left?

adjustableVariables: Musician's pose (as long as hands remain on guitar)
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or record label logos
Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the musician.
Ensure the guitar headstock is clearly visible under the hands.
Verify the ochre color is consistent across all text elements.
Confirm the background texture looks like physical material (plaster/paint).
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key vertical portrait on the left with heavy condensed serif typography on the right, linked by a textured dark void and a simple geometric divider.
